figure.note: Across all stills she keeps the sheet's curvy hourglass figure: full bust, narrow waist, wide hips and full thighs in the fitted top and pencil skirt. No visible slimming.

issues.note: Her eyes read dark brown from 3.4s onward (also 4.9, 6.5, 8.0, 9.5, 14.1s) instead of the light silver-grey in the references. At 0.3s they are only lightish/hazel. The eye colour has drifted away from her distinctive light eyes.
Lids are somewhat heavy and lowered, and her gaze reads slightly sleepy.
Heavy, lowered lids with the irises partly covered.
Eyes are nearly half-closed and looking downward, with the irises largely hidden. This continues the heavy-lidded look from 11.1s.
Her right hand is raised palm-out to lower-chest height, above the requested waist level.
Her right hand gestures at chest height and stays raised through 11.1s, 12.6s and 14.1s without returning to rest at her side.

summary: Framing, scene, outfit and figure are stable, and gestures stay one-handed, though often at chest height. The clip fails mainly on identity: her light silver-grey eyes turn dark brown from 3.4s on. There are also heavy-lidded moments around 11.1–12.6s.
